project.name: Campus Attendance System
project.objective: Initial project initialization for Campus Attendance System

recommendations: Sign off on 1 unapproved/proposed architectural decision(s).

requirements.title: User Authentication
requirements.description: the System shall authenticate registered users using secure credentials before granting access to workflows.
constraints: Passwords must be hashed using bcrypt or Argon2
acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials successfully generate access tokens
Invalid credentials reject with HTTP 401 Unauthorized

requirements.title: Core Domain Action Execution
requirements.description: WHEN an authorized user submits a record or action request, the System shall record and store the operational log with UTC timestamp and actor identity.
acceptance_criteria: Submitted actions are committed with immutable audit timestamp

requirements.title: Network Disconnection / Fault Handling
requirements.description: IF the network connection is lost during data submission, THEN the System shall queue pending local transactions and display a non-blocking offline alert.
acceptance_criteria: Reconnection synchronizes queued records to the backend

decisions.title: Database Engine
decisions.reason: ACID transactional safety for attendance and grade records

rejected_alternatives.reason_rejected: Lack of relational integrity for enrollment
